secrets.how: pull the red book: the shelf turns into the confessional
climb into the dumbwaiter and haul the rope (2 floors)
the portrait swings open; a ladder behind the clock face. Its eyes are a peephole over the meeting table
slide the lid of Pozzo senior's tomb; steps down to a false wine rack
the old well under the greenhouse drains into the cistern; iron rungs
the back of the nursery wardrobe: a crawl between the walls to Pozzo's bedroom
the card room hearth's back plate swings in: a sooty stair up behind Pozzo's wardrobes
the altar slab slides aside: steps down to the Pozzo crypt
a low hatch behind the servants' dresser: a crawl between the walls to the music room
a panel beside the gold room's bed: a ladder up to Anselm's hidden observatory
